_doc: One business's settings for the sales agent (replies and the CRM in one agent). Names of things only: no key, no address, no contact, no private figure.
host: the Grok team, on test. Any other agent that files or answers in this CRM keeps doing so until the owner switches it off and says pinnacle-ghl: bot

crm.name: GoHighLevel (Pinnacle Funding Group)
crm.note_link_field: named at intake: the contact field that holds the vault note's link
crm.writes_when: context/owners.md says pinnacle-ghl: bot and context/routines-on.md says crm-writes: on; until then every write is a proposal in requests/justin/

vault.note_rule: made on the first reply, attached to the CRM contact, added to on every reply and answer, read before every draft

inboxes.note: the one source where people give contact details and consent themselves; worked first

inboxes.inbox: public threads the Radar found (Reddit and the web)
inboxes.sent_by: a person, from the draft (nobody posts yet)

inboxes.read_by: the Funding Radar and the worker's Facebook lanes

inboxes.inbox: cold email inboxes: cold lead campaigns
cold email inboxes: Dream 500 and partner campaigns
inboxes.note: off until the domain decision; Dream 500 campaigns carry from_agent dream-500 by campaign name
off until the owner says how the VPS takes work
this business has no LinkedIn lane
off until carrier registration is approved

answer.as: Find Me Money, first person, plain
public_reply: no link and no 'DM me' or 'call me' (the checker enforces it)
a first reply asks for nothing
answer.never_says: a rate, an approval, an amount or a date; the names in FCM_NEVER_SAY

runs.reply_check: the Reply routine, three times a day

_inboxes_doc: from_agent is the outreach agent the inbox (or the campaign in the sending tool) belongs to. It decides the pipeline and the source tag. Nothing sorts a person into lead or partner.

nurture.where: the CRM's own workflows (the four ids given at intake); publishing or editing one is the owner's yes
nurture.approval: each campaign approved once, as a whole

_list_doc: Still in, waiting on the owner's keep or remove (STATUS.md, the list at the top): crm.writer, crm.never, crm.read_only_pipelines, vault.contact_details_in_notes, always_the_owners, follow_up.max_follow_ups, the SMS inbox's note, opt_out in nurture.leave_on.
